# arrowlane-rust

arrowlane moves a tabular batch between processes as a validated frame. The Rust
core is wire compatible with the Python package of the same name.

Use this file as the first context for an agent or a build tool.

## Build and test

```bash
cargo build --release
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
```

The release build contains the `arrowlane` CLI and the `arrowlane_ffi` C ABI.

## Contract

- Wire format: 38 byte prefix, UTF-8 JSON header, opaque payload. Magic `ALN1`.
- Lanes: `json`, `ipc`, `ipc-zstd`, and `shm` on POSIX.
- Selection is deterministic and matches the Python selector.
- Every frame length is capped before allocation. Every payload has a CRC32.
- A chunk is a complete frame with `chunk: {id, index, last}`.

## Resource rules

- `pack_chunks` is lazy. It encodes chunk n+1 only when the consumer asks.
- `read_chunks` and `unpack_chunks` return lazy iterators. They do not buffer the
  whole stream.
- `assemble_chunks` is the only call that joins all chunks into one batch.
- `transit_chunks` plans from row and byte totals and returns a lazy iterator.

## Agent entry points

- `AGENTS.md` is the short command card.
- `arrowlane describe --compact` prints the machine-readable capability manifest.
- `docs/ai/manifest.json` is the static manifest.
- `docs/ai/quickstart.md` has a minimal Rust example.
- `docs/ai/api.md` lists the public calls and their return shapes.

## Safety

- `shm` descriptors are untrusted. Range arithmetic is checked before mapping.
- The FFI release profile uses `panic = "unwind"`, so `catch_unwind` works.
- Buffers returned across the FFI are freed with `al_free`; reason strings are
  freed with `al_free_reason`.
- CRC32 is not a MAC. Use TLS for remote traffic.

## Interoperability

```bash
python interop/check_wire.py --rust target/release/arrowlane.exe --rows 50000
python interop/check_select.py --rust target/release/arrowlane.exe
cd interop && python check_ffi.py
```

The Python package and pyarrow environment live beside this repository in
`../arrowlane`.
